primary_endpoint_1.name: response_time_damper_ms
primary_endpoint_1.interpretation: Damper response < 200ms = PASS (faster than ASD's modeled 500ms). > 1000ms = FAIL (slower than ASD). 200-1000ms = AMBIGUOUS.
primary_endpoint_1.statistical_method: Two-sided 95% CI of 10 replicates must be entirely below 200ms for PASS, entirely above 1000ms for FAIL.

primary_endpoint_2.name: proportional_error_pct
primary_endpoint_2.interpretation: Damper proportional error < 15% = PASS (closer to target than ASD's binary behavior). > 30% = FAIL. 15-30% = AMBIGUOUS.
primary_endpoint_2.statistical_method: Two-sided 95% CI of 40 measurements (4 postures × 10 replicates) must be entirely below 15% for PASS, entirely above 30% for FAIL.

overall_verdict_rule.PASS: Both endpoints PASS (95% CI entirely below pass threshold on both)
overall_verdict_rule.FAIL: Either endpoint FAIL (95% CI entirely above fail threshold on either)
overall_verdict_rule.AMBIGUOUS: Any endpoint AMBIGUOUS (95% CI spans pass/fail boundary) without any FAIL

statistical_method: Standard t-distribution CI (n=10 for endpoint 1, n=40 for endpoint 2)
article_XXVII_compliance: Every threshold has provenance: pass_threshold=200ms derived from ASD's modeled 500ms response (damper must be meaningfully faster). fail_threshold=1000ms derived from clinical irrelevance (postural transitions take 1-3s). proportional_error thresholds derived from target flow 0.3 mL/min ± 15% = clinically acceptable range.
